title: Lithic testimonial carousel
description: A short intro on the left and a row of large faint-bronze quote cards running off the right edge of the window; arrow buttons under the row slide it one card at a time (also swipeable). Each card: a customer wordmark, a 20px quote with a hanging open-quote, and an avatar with name and role.
notes: a native scroll-snap track: swipe/scroll works without JavaScript; the arrows need it
on phones the intro stays beside the track and the first card peeks in from the right, as the original
the avatar is a media slot (48px circle placeholder); company names are text marks
